bots.title: Bots

guide.title: How to build a bot
guide.intro: Bots work like Discord bots: create one here, copy the token once, then call the HTTP API from any language that can send requests. You do not need the browser custom client header — that header is only for the official web app (DDoS filter).
guide.step1: 1. Create a bot below and copy the token (shown only once).
guide.step2: 2. In Channel settings → Bots, add the bot to the channel you want it to post in.
guide.step3: 3. Send requests with Authorization: Bearer <token> to https://api.klovy.chat
